abetifi-college-of-education-abetifi.overview: Abetifi Presbyterian College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Abetifi in the Eastern Region.

accra-college-of-education-accra.overview: Accra College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Accra, serving students preparing to teach in Ghana’s schools.

atebubu-college-of-education-atebubu.overview: Atebubu College of Education is a public teacher-training institution based in Atebubu in the Bono East Region.

college-of-health-yamfo.overview: College of Health, Yamfo is a health training institution in the Ahafo Region. The college includes departments in physician assistantship, medical laboratory sciences, health promotion, health information management, and disease control and epidemiology.

photos.alt: Laboratory facilities at College of Health, Yamfo
A teaching facility pictured in the College of Health, Yamfo gallery
Buildings and grounds at College of Health, Yamfo

college-of-nursing-ntotroso.overview: The College of Nursing and Midwifery in Ntotroso trains nurses and midwives in the Ahafo Region, combining classroom education with supervised clinical and simulation training.

photos.alt: Students on the College of Nursing and Midwifery campus in Ntotroso
Supervised clinical simulation at the College of Nursing and Midwifery in Ntotroso

dambai-college-of-education-dambai.overview: Dambai College of Education is a public teacher-training institution based in Dambai in the Oti Region.

holy-family-nurses-and-midwifery-trainin.overview: Holy Family Nursing and Midwifery Training College is a Catholic health training institution in Berekum. Its website publishes information for applicants and reports on students’ clinical education.

photos.alt: A clinical training equipment donation at Holy Family NMTC Berekum

holy-family-nurses-training-college-nkaw.overview: Holy Family Catholic Nursing and Midwifery Training College is based in Nkawkaw. The college publishes information on nursing and midwifery programmes, admissions and training facilities.

jasikan-college-of-education-jasikan.overview: Jasikan College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Jasikan in the Oti Region. The University of Cape Coast’s Institute of Education maintains a page for the college.

photos.alt: Jasikan College of Education, pictured by the University of Cape Coast

narh-bita-college.overview: Narh-Bita College is a private health training college in Tema. It publishes information on its nursing and allied health programmes and student services.

nursing-and-midwifery-training-college-a.overview: Presbyterian Nursing and Midwifery Training College in Agogo trains nurses and midwives in the Ashanti Region.

nursing-training-college-ho.overview: Nursing Training College, Ho is a public health training institution in the Volta Region. Its website provides school information, student resources and links to the government health training admissions portal.

nursing-and-midwifery-training-college-k.overview: Nursing and Midwifery Training College, Kumasi is a public health training college whose official site provides programme details, an academic calendar and campus news.

photos.alt: Nursing and Midwifery Training College, Kumasi, as pictured on the school website

nursing-and-midwifery-training-college-k.overview: Nursing and Midwifery Training College, Korle Bu is a public health training college in Accra. The college trains nursing and midwifery students and publishes admissions notices and campus news on its official site.

photos.alt: Nursing and Midwifery Training College, Korle Bu campus and students

presbyterian-women-s-college-of-educatio.overview: Presbyterian Women’s College of Education is a teacher-training college in Aburi. Its official site shares information on early-grade and primary education, admissions and college activities.

photos.alt: A college news photo from Presbyterian Women’s College of Education

royal-ann-college-of-health.overview: Royal Ann College of Health is a private college in Abuakwa Manhyia, Kumasi. It publishes information about its nursing and allied health training, including medical laboratory and dispensing programmes.

photos.alt: Medical laboratory studies shown by Royal Ann College of Health
A nursing programme photo from Royal Ann College of Health

nursing-and-midwifery-training-college-t.overview: Nursing and Midwifery Training College, Twifo Praso is a public health training institution in Ghana’s Central Region. The school publishes guidance for applicants, notices and news about college activities.

sda-nursing-and-midwifery-training-colle.overview: SDA Nursing and Midwifery Training College in Kwadaso provides nursing and midwifery training. The institution’s site includes programme information, library resources and campus news.

sda-college-of-education-agona-ashanti.overview: Seventh-day Adventist College of Education, Agona-Ashanti is a teacher-training college. Its official site provides programme information and publishes campus news.

st-john-bosco-college-of-education-navro.overview: St. John Bosco’s College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Navrongo, in the Kassena-Nankana area of the Upper East Region.

photos.alt: A college cultural activity at St. John Bosco’s College of Education
Campus life at St. John Bosco’s College of Education

st-ambrose-college-of-education-dormaa-a.overview: St. Ambrose College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Dormaa Akwamu. The college’s official site shares information on its early-grade, primary and junior high education programmes.

photos.alt: Campus life at St. Ambrose College of Education, pictured by the college

st-john-of-god-college-of-health-duayaw-.overview: St. John of God College of Health is based in Duayaw Nkwanta. The college website provides admissions and campus visit information for prospective health training students.

st-karol-school-of-nursing.overview: St. Karol School of Nursing is a private nursing school in Greater Accra. Its site provides programme, student life and facilities information.

photos.alt: A view of training at St. Karol School of Nursing

st-louis-college-of-education-kumasi.overview: St. Louis College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Kumasi. Its website shares the college’s history and information on student life.

tumu-college-of-education.overview: Tumu College of Education is a public teacher-training college in Tumu in the Upper West Region. Its website publishes programme information and notices on college life and student activities.

photos.alt: Students of Tumu College of Education, pictured by the college
A second student life photo from Tumu College of Education

wiawso-college-of-education.overview: Wiawso College of Education trains teachers in the Western North Region. The school publishes campus news and photos and provides student resources through its official website.

photos.alt: Wiawso College of Education, pictured on its official website
